doc: Trace format v1: one JSON object per line. This file is the source of truth, owned by codeterminal-core (daemon/trace); the viewer (mochiii_visual) reads a copy. A reader ignores fields and stages it does not know (the viewer draws an unknown stage as unmapped), refuses a different major v, and rejects a line longer than max_line_bytes. An emitter writes only the fields listed here, only the stages listed here, and only error classes from error_classes.

field_notes.turn: an id that joins one turn's lines across processes (lower-case letters and digits, 1-16)
field_notes.stage: one of the closed stage list
field_notes.dur_ms: duration of the stage, for ok and fail
field_notes.tool: the subject: a resolved tool name (builtin__read_file, github__create_issue), a catalog command name without its slash (fix), or a request kind (prompt)
field_notes.call: a daemon counter for tool calls within the turn, 0 when not a tool call
field_notes.err: an error class from a closed set, empty unless status is fail
field_notes.sid: the first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the client's session name; written only on a turn's first line, and only when the client named a session. The name itself is never written

error_classes_note: the closed set an emitter may write in err: daemon ModelErrorClass (modelerror.go), the audit* decision sources that refuse a call, protocol.Incomplete*, and the two tool failure classes; anything else is written as other
